title: Web need: download a sample's markup (or one clip) as DAW clip files
description:
## Intent

Describe what the web app would need; the web/docs session designs it.

## The need

- In the Library, on a sample: "Download clips for the DAW", producing the same folder (as a zip) the CLI writes.
- On a clip row (automatic ones included): "Download clip file" for that one clip.
- Source of the bytes: `apricity serve` (local library; e.g. `GET /export/clips?sample=<id>` returning a zip), or the wasm engine; the audio must be on the user's machine for the files to play, so in cloud mode the UI must say so or include the audio (owner decision from M0).
- Show the file name a clip will get (`A-1bar-Fm`) next to its Apricity name, so the two can be matched.

## Verification

Done when the web session has accepted the need in its own issue (comment with its id).

## Release

No product commit here.

## Dependencies

Blocked by the CLI task.
